news.headline: Delcath Systems Shares Set New 52-Week High of $17.42
news.summary: DCTH shares touched a fresh 52-week high of $17.42 intraday, extending a rally built on the Q2 earnings beat, raised full-year guidance, and a string of analyst price-target increases.

news.headline: Delcath Systems to Participate at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
news.summary: Delcath management presented at the Canaccord Genuity growth conference in Boston on August 11, 2026, keeping the stock in front of generalist and specialist healthcare investors following the Q2 beat.

news.headline: H.C. Wainwright Raises Delcath Systems Price Target to $32 from $30, Reiterates Buy
news.summary: H.C. Wainwright lifted its price target on DCTH shares following the strong Q2 print, citing robust HEPZATO adoption and continued growth momentum.

news.headline: BTIG Raises Delcath Systems Price Target to $21 from $17, Maintains Buy
news.summary: BTIG boosted its target price the same day Delcath reported Q2 results, pointing to accelerating HEPZATO volume growth and the raised 2026 revenue outlook.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Highlights
news.summary: Q2 revenue rose 20% year-over-year to $29.1M ($27.1M from HEPZATO KIT) on roughly 30% volume growth, gross margin expanded to 90%, and net income held at $2.7M; management raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M and reaffirmed a target of 37 active U.S. treatment centers by year-end (31 active as of Q2).

news.headline: Delcath Systems Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 2 Clinical Trial of HEPZATO in Liver-Dominant Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: The first patient was dosed at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in a new investigator-initiated Phase 2 study of HEPZATO in HER2-negative, liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer, extending the platform beyond uveal melanoma.

catalysts.label: US site network expansion
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for roughly six more HEPZATO treatment centers to go live, reaching 37 active US sites by year-end 2026 (31 active as of Q2), with 40 centers targeted by Q1 2027.

catalysts.label: FDA pre-IND meetings for new indications
catalysts.detail: Management plans pre-IND discussions with the FDA to pursue additional HEPZATO indications beyond uveal melanoma, building on early breast and colorectal cancer signal data.

catalysts.label: Phase 2 metastatic breast cancer trial enrollment
catalysts.detail: Investigator-initiated Phase 2 study of HEPZATO in HER2-negative liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer is enrolling across six activated sites following the first patient dosed in July 2026.

catalysts.label: Phase 2 metastatic colorectal cancer trial
catalysts.detail: Sponsored Phase 2 trial of HEPZATO as add-on therapy in liver-dominant metastatic colorectal cancer now has 13 centers actively screening across the US and Europe; primary endpoint results are anticipated around mid-2028.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Delcath's next quarterly results and updated guidance/site-activation commentary are expected in the November 2026 reporting window (exact date not yet announced).

pulse: Delcath enters the back half of 2026 from a position of commercial strength: Q2 revenue jumped 20% year-over-year to $29.1M on roughly 30% HEPZATO volume growth, prompting management to raise FY26 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M and triggering a wave of analyst price-target hikes (BTIG to $21, H.C. Wainwright to $32), with the stock touching a fresh 52-week high of $17.42 in mid-August. The story is broadening beyond core uveal melanoma commercialization, with the US treatment-center network expanding toward 37 sites by year-end and a newly dosed Phase 2 trial in metastatic breast cancer signaling a push toward a multi-indication liver-directed therapy platform. Near-term catalysts remain execution-driven (site activations, FDA pre-IND discussions on new indications) rather than binary regulatory events, with the next major data readout (colorectal primary endpoint) not expected until around 2028.
